title: Guilded Eggstravaganza
start: Talk to the Easter Bunny at the Eastertime Fete by the Lumbridge Crater.

rewards.t: Bunny-hop, Around the World in Eggty Days, Invoke Spring, Butterfly Dervish, Cabbage Facepunch Bonanza, Egg Juggler, Easter Trick or Treat, Human to Bunny emote variant of the Easter Trick or Treat emote (if not unlocked previously)

steps.t: Talk to the Easter Bunny in the Lumbridge Crater to start the quest. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Guilded Eggstravaganza'... (Quest) › Accept]
Talk to the Cooks' Guild Apprentice, just north of the Easter Bunny. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Make the Cake of pies on the Cooks' Guild range. [Chat: 1 Yes.]

sub.t: Bring an uncooked redberry pie, uncooked meat pie, and an uncooked apple pie.

steps.t: Talk to the Cooks' Guild Apprentice. [Chat: 1 Here is the cake of pies.]
Make a Lemon pie.

sub.t: Take a Luxury lemon from the crate.
Create an Uncooked lemon pie by using the Luxury lemon on a pie shell.
Cook the Uncooked lemon pie on the Cooks' Guild range.

steps.t: Talk to the Cooks' Guild Apprentice. [Chat: 1 Here is the lemon pie.]
Talk to the Crafting Guild Apprentice, west of the Cooks' Guild Apprentice. [Chat: 1 Yes. › Any › 2 Let's do it!]
Fill your empty pot with salt from the Barrel of salt by the Cooks' Guild Apprentice and head back to talk to the Crafting Guild Apprentice.
Heat the gold and pot of salt twice at the Crafting Guild's Furnace. [Chat: 1 Heat the gold. › 1 It needs to be hotter. › 2 That'll do.]
Talk to the Crafting Guild Apprentice.
Fill your bucket with vinegar from the Barrel of Vinegar by the Cooks' Guild Journeywoman.
Talk to the Crafting Guild Apprentice.
Paint the egg at the Crafting Guild's Workbench nearby.
Talk to the Crafting Guild Apprentice.
Use the Bag of flawless gems on the Unadorned imperial egg.
Talk to the Crafting Guild Apprentice.
Talk to the Fishing Guild Apprentice, south of the Cooks' Guild Apprentice.
Talk to Ames the Courtier. He can be found northwest by the furnace.
Get a Beautiful bucket of flowers.

sub.t: Go to the Lumbridge General Store.
Talk to the Shopkeeper. [Chat: 1 Ask about flowers for Easter. › 1 Yes]

steps.t: Talk to Ames the Courtier.
Talk to the Fishing Guild Apprentice.
Talk to the Easter Bunny. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Guilded Eggstravaganza'... (Quest) › ~]
